d: Nitish setu ke namakran aur kal hone vale iske udghatan karyakram ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men saspens aur bayanbaji donon tej ho gaee hain. midiya dvara jab nitish kumar se puchha gaya ki unke nam par pul ka namakran huaa hai aur kal udghatan hai, is par ve kya kahenge aur kya ve karyakram men jaenge— to is saval ko sunte hi nitish kumar ne hath jor lie aur bina koee javab die chuppi sadhe aage barh gae.
